title: G16-backed safeguarded tangent coupling orchestration and final publication seam

earlier_validation_run.reason: The subsequent harness postimage added explicit binding checks for all frozen G17 preregistration constants and workflow path tracking without changing runtime or numerical orchestration semantics.

bounded_conclusions: The qualified G16 service can supply every SWAP-side diagnostic evaluation needed by the unchanged research E3/P4 safeguard path in the frozen G11 live-overshoot stress.
The raw physical-Newton proposal remains participant status 6 and P4 performs exactly two factor-1/2 contractions before converging in three outer updates to the persisted G11 solution.
Across the complete solve, 67 logical observation requests are served by 34 physical participant trials and 33 exact-head cache hits; no ordinary publication-path trial is used during diagnostics.

Every diagnostic trial remains non-authoritative: no live participant candidate survives an observation, FMR preflight remains false, ledger preflight remains false, and accepted revision/time/committed-ledger state remain unchanged.

After convergence, closing G16 still leaves no publication authority. Exactly one ordinary participant trial at the converged head reacquires the final candidate; its q is identical to the cached diagnostic q.
The existing FMR preflight plus ledger prepare/preflight and nominal sequential commit path publishes the final candidate and reproduces a fresh-process direct-publication control exactly.
The observed intermediate state after SWAP commit but before ledger commit demonstrates why this result is not evidence of crash-atomic publication.
The live MODFLOW6 calculations in G17 remain proposal/merit solves, not a persistent transactional MODFLOW participant. Production coupling orchestration is therefore not yet admitted.
next_natural_unit: Define and qualify the missing publication/transaction architecture: persistent MODFLOW participant ownership plus crash-safe multi-participant publication semantics, before any E3/P4 or HCOF/RHS production admission.
